summary: On paper this one is close: the Jets's best edge is to finish drives (The Jets rank 26th in red-zone TD rate, 59%). Under center, Kirk Cousins ranks 11th of 30 in EPA per dropback and Geno Smith ranks 19th; x-factor: Braelon Allen gains +1.2 rushing yards over expected per carry, 3rd of 30, and Las Vegas' run defense ranks 26th. The model favors the Jets at 53%, mostly on rushing matchup (2.3 pts) and home field (1.6 pts).
